Q: Converting jQuery to Pure JavaScript A:

Your attempt is creating a function. Remove the arrow function item => like so.

let gridIndexValue = [...item.parentNode.children].indexOf(item)

Q: Why are double quotes being stripped away when passed as command line arguments? A:

The issue is that the terminal is actually stripping the double quotes away, long before Java ever gets its hands on it.

When you put something in double quotes on the terminal, Git Bash (as well as pretty much any other terminal) will try and help you out by evaluating the stuff in the double quotes, like swapping "$abc" for the actual value of the variable at abc. This is, effectively, what is happening here. It tries to evaluate the double quotes, and then strips them away when done evaluating.

If the double quotes are what you actually need, you can escape them with backslashes on Git Bash.
